preparedBy: AI authoring assistant (Claude) at the owner's request
statement: What the module is permitted to do with each thing it uses. Nothing here is a rights decision: every decision reads NOT REVIEWED. An item marked as blocking upload may be built and used on the build machine. It may not be uploaded to storage or published, because any model or data file on the site can be fetched without signing in.

items.what: The CT the anatomy is derived from
items.termsSource: The dataset's Zenodo record, doi 10.5281/zenodo.10069289, read on 2026-09-28
items.permits: Sharing and adapting, including commercially, with credit, a link to the licence and a note of changes.
requires: Credit to the dataset and the paper that describes it
A statement that the material was modified
items.use: Surfaces, ribs and landmarks are derived from it. The scan itself is never distributed.
items.openQuestion: The scan is asserted to be case 19 of the dataset. That has not been verified against the archive.

items.termsSource: The segmentation file's own tags, which name TotalSegmentator and MONAI Auto3DSeg as the sources of its segments
items.use: Surfaces are built from its segments. Segments are identified by measured content, because the file's segment names do not match what the segments contain.
items.openQuestion: Which models produced which segments, who ran them, what was edited by hand, and whether the models' terms allow a sponsored course to publish what they produced.

items.what: Frames of the manufacturer's product animation
items.use: Looked at and measured. Never committed, never uploaded, never sent to a third-party service, never shown to a learner. Comparison sheets that contain them stay in the owner's local data.
items.openQuestion: Whether the manufacturer will license stills or footage for teaching.

items.what: Manufacturer sell sheet, brochures and catalogue
items.terms: Published by the manufacturer. No licence to reproduce has been granted
items.permits: Citing facts, with the document and page.
items.use: Dimensions and part numbers are cited. No text, table or image is reproduced.
items.heldAt: The owner's machine. Not yet gathered into local data
items.openQuestion: Permission to keep copies together in local data.

items.what: Device records in the FDA device database
items.holder: Public record, submitted by the manufacturer
items.terms: Published by a US government agency for public use
items.permits: Citing facts, with the device identifier and version date.
items.use: Dimensions and descriptions are cited. A record is not a fact-check.

items.what: The module's 3D models of the instruments
items.terms: Original work, built for this module from published dimensions and measurements
requires: No manufacturer logo or wordmark on any model
The label 'Educational rendering from published dimensions' wherever a model is shown
items.openQuestion: Who owns the models under the sponsorship agreement, and whether depicting the manufacturer's product design needs the manufacturer's permission.

items.permits: Naming the product in plain text to identify it.
requires: The attribution format the manufacturer supplies, once it does
items.use: Product names appear as plain text.
items.openQuestion: The manufacturer's trademark attribution format and the US product names.
